name: Request & Domain Validation
description: Canonical standard for Request & Domain Validation. Defines baseline rules, review expectations and adoption guidance for projects where this standard applies.

rules.title: Define an explicit Request & Domain Validation approach before implementation
rules.detail: Document scope, decisions, constraints and ownership for Request & Domain Validation; link the decision to relevant requirements and implementation evidence.
rules.example_good: The project records how Request & Domain Validation applies, who owns it, and how compliance is verified.
rules.example_bad: Request & Domain Validation is implemented ad hoc without documented rules or review evidence.

rules.title: Handle failure, boundary and compatibility cases explicitly
rules.detail: Identify relevant failure modes, edge cases, compatibility constraints and rollback/recovery expectations before release.
rules.example_good: Boundary and failure cases are represented in acceptance criteria, tests, checks or operational guidance.
rules.example_bad: Only the happy path is defined and failures are left to implementation guesswork.

rules.title: Verify adoption with repeatable evidence
rules.detail: Use automated checks where practical and manual review where judgement is required; record justified deviations instead of silently ignoring rules.
rules.example_good: Review or automated evidence shows which rules were checked and any approved exceptions.
rules.example_bad: The standard exists as documentation but is not referenced during delivery or review.

integration_guide.title: Assess applicability
integration_guide.description: Determine whether STD-BE-VALID applies to the project, feature or change and record approved exclusions.

integration_guide.title: Apply standard
integration_guide.description: Apply the relevant Request & Domain Validation rules during requirement, design and implementation work.

integration_guide.title: Verify compliance
integration_guide.description: Run relevant automated checks and manual review, then capture evidence or approved deviations before completion.

common_issues.issue: Inconsistent adoption of Request & Domain Validation
common_issues.cause: The project profile does not resolve or assign the applicable standard clearly.
common_issues.solution: Reference STD-BE-VALID explicitly, assign ownership and include it in review/quality gates.

common_issues.issue: Rules are documented but not verifiable
common_issues.cause: No test, lint, checklist, review evidence or operational check is tied to the rule.
common_issues.solution: Pair each important rule with practical verification evidence and record exceptions.
